identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study to Evaluate Tolerability and Immunogenicity of V504 Administered Concomitantly With GARDASIL (V504-001)(COMPLETED)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-Blinded, Tolerability and Immunogenicity Study of a Multivalent Human Papillomavirus (HPV) L1 Virus-Like Particle (VLP) Vaccine Administered Concomitantly With GARDASIL to 16- to 26- Year-Old Women

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate vaccine immunogenicity and how well the body tolerates V504 when given with Gardasil.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Females between 16- to 26-years-old
* Has never had Pap testing or has only had normal Pap test results.
* Lifetime history of 0 to 4 sexual partners

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of an abnormal cervical biopsy result
* History of a positive test for HPV; History of external genital/vaginal warts
* Currently a user of illegal drugs or an alcohol abuser
* History of severe allergic reaction that required medical attention
* Are pregnant
* Received a marketed HPV vaccine
* Currently enrolled in a clinical trial
* Currently has or has a history of certain medical conditions or is currently taking or has taken certain medications (details will be discussed at the time of consent)
